Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: www.sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SAI Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.sportsauthorityofindia.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 28-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

content_sections.heading: SAI Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Sports Authority of India (SAI). It is a prominent government body promoting sports in the country.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for which applications are invited?
faq.answer: Applications are invited for the post of Medical Officer. This role is crucial for supporting the health and well-being of athletes.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the Medical Officer position in the Sports Authority of India recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for SAI Medical Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Medical Officer post is 28 September 2026. Candidates should ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the SAI Medical Officer recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to download, fill, and send the application form by post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Medical Officer post is 56 years. Age relaxation may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS degree with 3 years post-internship experience, or PGDSM with 1 year experience, or PG/DNB in Sports medicine/Orthopaedics/PMR/equivalent.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Medical Officer post ranges from Rs. 67700 to Rs. 208700 Per Month, which is a competitive government pay scale.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the SAI Medical Officer Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Officer post involves an Interview, followed by the preparation of a Merit List based on performance and eligibility.
